title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Permission risk, right in the manifest
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.33.0 adds inline risk pills on AndroidManifest.xml permission lines, showing each permission's risk level without a hover.

highlights.title: Permission Risk Badges
highlights.description: Shows a risk pill directly on each uses-permission line in AndroidManifest.xml, so dangerous or signature-level permissions are visible without opening a hover.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added inline risk pills on AndroidManifest.xml uses-permission lines, marking each permission as normal, dangerous, or signature level right in the manifest.
Available in both desktop VS Code and VS Code for the Web.
Can be turned off via the kotlinJump.manifestPermissionBadges setting.
